items.title: Learn Why The Bull Case For Wells Fargo Shares Could Change Following ETF Inflows
items.summary: Wells Fargo has recently issued a series of fixed rate senior unsecured notes across maturities from 2030 to 2046, while ETFs and other institutional vehicles added roughly US$54.7 million of exposure over several days and the board affirmed a quarterly dividend of US$0.50 per share. The combination of fresh bond funding, a growing role in large credit facilities, expanding affordable housing finance, and sustained ETF accumulation reflects investors focusing on Wells Fargo's balance sheet...
